blind_target.title: Developmental and individual differences in pure numerical estimation.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The primary purpose of this study was the use of a number-line assessment to replicate the logarithmic-to-linear shift pattern in positive number sense explored by Booth and Siegler (2006), as well as to examine the hypothesized parallel logarithmic-to-linear shift using negative numbers.
